BEFORE YOU BEGIN

A few things you might be wondering.

About building booking apps with Atomic.

Can I begin with a booking template?

Yes. The Salon Booking template brings services, stylists, opening hours, booking screens, a staff day view, and an owner dashboard. Explore it with sample data, then adapt the app to your business.

Can I test the experience as different people?

Yes. Use the role preview to see the app as a customer, staff member, or owner. The sample account for each role helps you check its screens and records.

Will this connect to my existing calendar or send reminders?

These pages do not promise calendar integrations or automated reminders. Include those requirements in your brief and confirm how the integration will work. Test any external service before relying on it.

Which plan supports real bookings?

Persistent booking data and user sign-in require a backend, included in the proposed Builder and Pro plans. Free supports frontend exploration. Review the launch plans and test data access and booking behaviour before going live.
